adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` entries are normalized to lowercase (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the filter checks `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` without lowercasing `guest`. This makes the blacklist case-sensitive on input, so an input like `EVIL@x.com` would not match a blacklist entry `evil@x.com` and would be allowed.
